_comment: sCure version registry - newest first. On every release: bump the VERSION file at the repo root AND add an entry here (version, date, notes). The Settings > Versions modal shows this list.

notes: HDT calibration: the heater fan stays at 100% even after a heater OFF — the heater-fan run-on (30% then all-fans-off) is cancelled when the run starts and the 100% duty is re-commanded every 5 s for the whole run; released to 0% at the end

PicoLog TC-08: the usbtc08 driver is also looked up in local driver dirs (/opt/picoscope/lib, ~/pico/root/opt/picoscope/lib, SCURE_TC08_LIB_DIR) — picosdk only consults the system loader cache, so a libusbtc08 .deb extracted with dpkg -x (no sudo) now works; test machine: TC-08 S/N AO114/209 connected

HDT calibration: the chamber heater fan runs at 100% for the whole run (HDT_HEATER_FAN_PWM) and is released to 0% on every exit path (complete / abort / HDT limit / sensor error); status publishes heaterFanPwm
QA: 'HDT Heater Fan 100%' test

QA tool: new 'Developer Mode' test category — dev-mode entry logic (10 presses / PIN 8176 / OFF after restart), LED factor persistence round-trip, calibrated system-power scaling (50% → 50.0/46.0/48.5/47.5, clamp at 100%), PicoLog TC-08 status fields, HDT start gate + default constants, and HDT recommendation logic (highest PASS ≤ HDT − margin)
Cure/Bleaching steps can now run WITHOUT chamber heating: 'Chamber Heating: Off (UV only)' in the step editor and the program builder — the heater stays off, UV and the step timer start immediately

No-heat UV steps get a 'Ventilation' option: On opens the damper and runs the chamber intake fan (fresh outside air, the same airflow path as cooling) for the whole UV exposure; released automatically at step end / stop / abort / next step
Ventilation fan duty configurable via components.json ventilation.fan_pwm (default 60%)
CSV format: Temperature 'off' on a Cure/Bleaching row = no heating; new 'Ventilation' column (on/off)
New API: POST /api/cure/uv-only?wavelength=405|450&intensity=..&vent=0|1; /api/state exposes ventOn
Hidden Developer Mode: 10 presses on the Settings gear open a password screen (session-only — always OFF after restart); DEVELOPER MODE banner + Exit on every dev screen

LED intensity calibration: independent Back/Door/Left/Right factors (persisted on the machine); one logical 'calibrated system LED power' drives all four zones through the factors everywhere — cure, diagnostics, HDT

Material HDT calibration: automatic 10–90% system-power sweep against the entered material HDT, measured on a PicoLog TC-08 (CH1) — moving average, 2°C/5min stability detection, 30 min timeout, hard HDT stop, recommended power = highest stabilized level at or below HDT minus safety margin
Live HDT screen: PicoLog/CH1 status gate, live temperature graph with HDT lines and power transitions, abort at any time; CSV + HTML report export (USB first), partial runs preserved
Safety: PicoLog disconnect, invalid/stale CH1 data, abort or any internal error force all four LED zones to the existing safe OFF state
Timestamped Developer Mode event log (server journal + server/data/dev_events.jsonl)

Fix: the step's 'Timer Start' setting is now honored by the cure screen — 'On ramp start' counts the step time through the temperature ramp (and may finish mid-ramp), 'On target' keeps waiting for the target as before. The setting was saved by the program builder but the cure screen ignored it
QA: new 'Timer Start Mode Honored' logic-mirror test

Real phase-timing analytics: every completed phase reports its true wall-clock duration (planned vs. actual, ramp share, start/end temps) to server/data/phase_timings.json on the machine; served at GET /api/phase-timings — the raw data for re-estimating real program times
Cure completion screen shows the TRUE total time — wall-clock from the moment the program started (was: sum of the hold timers only, ramps excluded)
QA: new 'Phase Timings Collected' test — endpoint shape + invalid records rejected

Fix: cure phase timers now track wall-clock time (performance.now() anchors) instead of counting 1s interval ticks — on the machine the browser fires ticks late under load and the lag accumulated, so timed phases ran minutes longer than programmed
QA: new 'Phase Timer Tracks Wall-Clock' test verifies late/missed ticks no longer stretch phase durations
Cloud portal: Stratasys header logo enlarged (26px -> 42px)
Cloud portal: Stratasys logo added to the header (embedded in the page, black-on-white to match the light theme)
Cloud portal: CureBox selector is now always visible (also with a single machine), with online/offline indicator per machine
Cloud portal: live search box — filters work programs and recent prints by name, material, printer or status as you type
Cloud portal: CureBox selector — when more than one machine is connected, tabs at the top let you show all machines or focus on one (choice is remembered)
Cloud portal: switched to a light black-on-white theme (white background, black text and buttons; green/red kept for online/offline status and errors)

Cloud portal fix: switching a step's process type now correctly swaps the row's fields (e.g. selecting Cooling shows the Fast/Medium/Slow mode and hides Time/UV) — previously the old fields stayed on screen

Cloud portal: program step editor now matches the machine UI — per-process fields (Cooling: target temp 30-75°C + cooling mode, no time; Cure/Bleaching: UV 10-100% + timer/UV start modes; Nitrogen: auto purge, no fields)
Cloud portal: saving validates the same limits and step-sequence rules as the machine (temperature ranges, N₂ purge rules, cooling must be 5°C below the previous step)
Heater fan cooldown run-on extended: 30% for 15 minutes (was 10) after every heating stop
Run-on is skipped only on door abort / process exit, or when a Cooling step takes over (it runs the heater fan at 100% itself)
Heating PI tuning: kp raised 0.08 -> 0.22 (faster ramp response; ki/kd unchanged)
Heating control changed to PI(D) + delta-sigma (replaces the ON/OFF 1°C thermostat)
50 ms control loop: kp=0.08, ki=0.00015/cycle, integrator clamp 0-0.85 (power 0..1)
Delta-sigma DAC streams the PI power to the heater element - average ON-time equals the commanded power
State exposes heaterPwm (commanded power %) + heaterOut (element ON right now)
Heater ON-hours counter now accumulates real element-energized time (heaterOut)
All PI gains tunable in components.json heating section; safety layer (pre-flight, health check, cooldown) unchanged
QA: Heater PI + Delta-Sigma test (power law + ON-ratio verified)
Fast cooling boost: the four LED-cooling fans (left/right/back/door) join the chamber fan in FAST mode
LED fans auto-release when cooling ends, on stop, on a mode change away from fast, and on door abort
Configurable via components.json cooling.fast_led_fan_pwm (default 100%, 0 disables)
Manual LED-fan control is blocked while the fast-cool boost owns the fans
QA: Fast Cool Engages LED Fans test (engage + release verified via /api/state)
First versioned release (versioning reset - single source of truth in VERSION file)
ON/OFF thermostat heating control with 1°C hysteresis (PI removed)
Fixed-duty cooling modes: fast 100% / medium 60% / slow 30%
Heater fan cooldown: 30% for 10 minutes after every heating stop (except door abort)
Real LAN + internet detection (eth0 carrier, live TCP-443 watch)
Component runtime counters (ON-hours per wear part)
Door-open safety abort with 10s grace countdown (Err 6016)
Central error registry + QA tool coverage
